title: 第21章 一不小心筑基成功第22章 你还真是一点都不谦虚
lines: 皱着眉头，林铮对所谓的黎家孙女婿，甚至是接管黎家都不感兴趣。
他已经有了未婚妻，怎么可能朝三暮四。
“师父，你是不是之前就已经猜到黎厉会如此，所以才会不辞而别。”
“小子，成为黎家的孙女婿也不错，算是得到一个强有劲的靠山，你可以考虑一下。”
“师父，要是你喜欢，我倒是可以帮你撮合。”
不敢继续留下，林铮真是感到头疼不已，以最快的速度跟着师父离开黎家。
路上。
“师父，血菩提到底是什么东西？”
“不清楚，但血菩提的存在，却是武者梦寐以求想要得到的东西。”
“对武道修炼有好处？”
“嗯，只是现在的你还无法炼化，不过我们可以慢慢想办法，等到炼化血菩提，你便可以慢慢融合，可以让你快速的提升自身修为。”
火玄笑着说道：“你小子这次运气不错，不仅得到血菩提，还得到了一门不错的炼丹术，回去后好好参悟，尽快的炼制更多的玄级凡品丹药，以你的天赋，相信一年内，应该可以尝试炼制地级凡品丹药。”
看着手里玉盒内的血菩提，林铮多少有些期待起来。
‘小子，我会帮你炼化血菩提，但单纯的融合，会让你遭受血菩提力量的反噬，虽然可以让你快速提升修为，不过反噬会很麻烦，得不偿失’
脑海里突然响起塔灵的声音。
眼神顿时一亮，自己怎么将塔灵忘了。
自己无法炼化，不代表塔灵做不到。
‘那何时才能炼化？’
‘先等着，等找到合适的灵草，再配合血菩提一起融合，这样便可以消除血菩提带来的反噬’
真是眼馋。
湮鼎宗。
连续吞服聚灵丹，并且在师父的全力相助下，短短的数十日时间，连续突破两个阶位，顺利晋级到巅峰聚灵境，只差一步，便可以正式开始筑基。
出来放松一天，从明天开始，他就要全力闭关冲击筑基境。
一旦顺利筑基，到时候萧焰便有着十足信心，能够击败林铮，哪怕是在生死台上都没有问题。
“清漪？”
看着不远处的身影，萧焰立刻走了上去。
“洛师妹，我有些事情想要找你。”
“何事？”
“不如去我的地方。”
“想说就说，不想说拉倒，我没空。”
心里一冷，萧焰却不敢动怒，毕竟如今的洛清漪身份已经今非昔比。
“数天前，父皇已经同意，让洛城主搬迁皇城，册封为将军。”
“替我多谢陛下。”
“洛师妹，恕我直言，以你的身份和天赋，林铮根本配不上你，只要你愿意，我可以替你向他解除婚约。”
恐怖的气势铺天盖地的涌出，吓的萧焰连连后退，满脸惊骇道：“二重筑基境！”
content_en:
Frowning, Lin Zheng was not interested in the so-called grandson-in-law of the Li family, or even taking over the Li family.
He already has a fiancée, so how could he be in a hurry.
"Master, did you already guess that Li Li would be like this before, that's why you left without saying goodbye?"
"Boy, becoming the grandson-in-law of the Li family is not bad. It will give you a strong backer. You can consider it."
"Master, if you like it, I can help you match it up."
"Get out!"
Not daring to stay any longer, Lin Zheng really felt a headache and followed his master as quickly as possible to leave the Li family.
On the road.
"Master, what exactly is Blood Bodhisattva?"
"I don't know, but the existence of Blood Bodhi is something that warriors dream of."
"Is it good for martial arts training?"
"Well, it's just that you can't refine it yet, but we can slowly find a way. When the Blood Bodhi is refined, you can slowly integrate it, which will allow you to quickly improve your own cultivation."
Huo Xuan smiled and said: "You are lucky this time. Not only did you get the Blood Bodhi, but you also got a good alchemy technique. After you go back, study it carefully and refine more Xuan-level mortal elixirs as soon as possible. With your talent, I believe you should be able to try to refine earth-level mortal elixirs within a year."
Looking at the Blood Bodhi in the jade box in his hand, Lin Zheng started to look forward to it.
'Boy, I will help you refine Blood Bodhi, but simple fusion will make you suffer the backlash of Blood Bodhi's power. Although it can help you quickly improve your cultivation, the backlash will be very troublesome and the gain will not be worth the loss.'
Ta Ling's voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
His eyes suddenly lit up, how could he forget about the tower spirit.
Just because you can't refine it yourself doesn't mean that the tower spirit can't do it.
‘When can it be refined? ’
'Wait first to find the suitable spiritual grass, and then fuse it with Blood Bodhi, so that the backlash caused by Blood Bodhi can be eliminated'
What a greedy person.
The Yin Ding Sect.
After continuously swallowing the spirit-gathering pills, and with the full help of the master, he broke through two levels in a row in just a few dozen days, and successfully advanced to the peak spirit-gathering realm. He was only one step away from officially starting to build the foundation.
He came out to relax for a day, and starting from tomorrow, he would go into seclusion with all his strength to attack the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Once the foundation is successfully established, Xiao Yan will have full confidence that he can defeat Lin Zheng, even on the stage of life and death.
"Qingyi?"
Looking at the figure not far away, Xiao Yan immediately walked up.
"Junior sister Luo, I have something I want to talk to you about."
"What's the matter?"
"Might as well go to my place."
"If you want to say something, just say it. If you don't want to talk about it, I don't have time."
Feeling cold in his heart, Xiao Yan did not dare to get angry. After all, Luo Qingyi's identity was no longer what it used to be.
"A few days ago, my father agreed to let the Lord of Luo City move to the imperial city and be conferred as a general."
"Thank you Your Majesty for me."
"Junior sister Luo, with all due respect, with your status and talent, Lin Zheng is not worthy of you at all. As long as you are willing, I can terminate your engagement with him on your behalf."
"Hmph!"
The terrifying aura surged out overwhelmingly, and Xiao Yan was so frightened that he stepped back again and again, and said with a look of horror on his face: "Second Level Foundation Establishment Realm!"
title_en: Chapter 21 Accidentally successful foundation building Chapter 22 You are really not humble at all
